decisions.reason: Chinese 今延祚以責賂之故，復加織羅 makes Yanzuo the agent of the renewed fabrications, so the original literal wrongly lets 'was fabricating' attach to Lü Mengqi. The proposal fixes that attribution, but dropping 'and thus he' leaves the main clause awkward; restore those words while keeping Yanzuo as fabricator.
